title: Kstack design manifest
description: Maps each local component and each screen of the Desktop Figma file to the code that draws it, with both sides' state at their last sync.

screens.description: One entry per section of the Screens page that holds a screen's frames. An entry's id starts with screens/.

id.description: The join key: the component's or screen's stamp in Figma carries it. Never changes, even when either side is renamed.

code.description: The files that draw a component, or lay a screen out. Absent while no code draws the component.

security.description: The component draws what the security model rests on: a change to it is a security change, not a restyle.

notes.description: What an agent translating this one component, in either direction, must know.

node.description: The component's or component set's node id, or the screen's section's.

name.description: The node's name at the last sync.

hash.description: The hash design/scripts/read-stamps.js gave the node at the last sync. Absent until recorded.

symbol.description: The component, function or constant in `path`, when the file holds more than this component.

blob.description: The file's git blob hash at the last sync (`git hash-object <path>`).
